source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Could u keep the app lightweight and maintainable while modernizing the 𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐎𝐒 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐨𝐢𝐝 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧? The scope should cover 𝐎𝐒/𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐮𝐩𝐝𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬, refactoring deprecated API, large-scale localization workflows, RTL support, app size optimization, and improved App Store/Google Play compliance.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: would you be able to finish everything listed above for $300?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I’ve completed 5 phases of the Android cleanup so far, and every phase resulted in a working APK that I can share with you anytime.

Completed work:

1\. Cleaned the repo — deleted 168 MB of residual build files that were cluttering the GitHub repo
2\. Eliminated unused permissions — removed READ\_PHONE\_STATE, which was causing Play Store warnings in some countries; removed unused storage permissions; and deleted dead ad code
3\. Deleted the Chinese/Youku video — as we discussed, it has been completely removed
4\. Updated deprecated code — the old measurement and splash screens now rely on modern Android APIs
5\. Replaced an abandoned UI library — exchanged 1,200 lines of outdated code (ViewFlow, last updated ~2014) for the modern Android ViewPager2

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports updating the measurement and splash screens to modern Android APIs and replacing the abandoned ViewFlow library with ViewPager2.

routing_warnings.description: The permission-removal clause supports Android permission compliance independently from API modernization.
The Youku-removal clause concerns the separate Chinese Youku video Requirement.
The measured APK-size reduction concerns Android download-size optimization rather than OS and API modernization.
